# Avsnitt 602 - Se upp för hackningar

**Feed**: fill-or-kill  
**Published**: 2026-10-13  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Fill or Kill episode 602 (13 Oct 2026) comes just before Q3 reporting season. The hosts discuss the profit warning from Hacksaw, the distressed European car sector (Volvo Cars), Meta's AI comeback and a sell-off in AI stocks. Cybersecurity is presented as a structural winner after several hacks (Asos, Dustin), with Yubico as the Swedish play, and SpaceX's spectrum purchase hit telecom operators such as Tigo. They describe market breadth as extremely narrow and the mood before the US midterm elections as cautious, and recommend holding cash. One host is long Snapchat ahead of two subscription-driven reports. A Savr analyst guest talks about biotech process, using Egetis, Saniona and Camurus as examples.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SNAP — Snapchat | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Host long ahead of early-Nov and January reports driven by mandatory storage subscription and buybacks.

#### Reasoning

Only 3% of users on paid storage already give a $1.2bn annual run rate. The paywall deadline in January should push more users to convert. Management targets zero net share issuance in 2027 via buybacks, which addresses the stock-based-pay dilution criticism. Two activist funds are involved. The host sees two good reports ahead (Nov and the one after the January deadline).

#### Sell Triggers

- if the November report shows weak subscription uptake
- if the buyback/zero-dilution target is abandoned
- if ad revenue deteriorates

> *"ser jag framför mig att det finns två bra rapporter om man inte behöver vara så skraj i Snapchat"*

---

### 🟠 HACK — Hacksaw | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Profit warning, ~30% drop and a credibility crisis; still 83% margin and ~9% cash flow yield.

#### Reasoning

Hosts are split. The high margin, buybacks and dividends could make it a value case. But growth turned negative QoQ, it may be a value trap, and management either had poor visibility or misled the market. The host tried to buy the dip but the rebound faded, Nelly-style, and shorts appeared. Listening to the report call is key.

#### Sell Triggers

- if revenue keeps declining (negative growth persists)
- if the report call fails to restore credibility
- if short positions build further

> *"Där är ju jury still out om vinsten är uthållig."*

---

### ⛔ VOLCAR-B — Volvo Cars | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Looks very cheap but competition from Chinese cars is brutal and the passenger-car sector is 'pitch black'.

#### Reasoning

European carmakers trade at extremely low valuations, but costs are too high and Chinese competition keeps getting worse. EU limits on hybrid imports help only temporarily. The new CEO from Skoda is a possible turnaround factor. A rights issue could trigger a bounce, but the outlook is foggy and it is hard to take a view.

#### Sell Triggers

- if EU trade protection proves durable
- if the new CEO delivers a Skoda-style turnaround
- if a successful rights issue resets the balance sheet

> *"just nu så känns ju biltillverkare på personbilar känns ju nattsvart"*

---

### 🟠 YUBICO — Yubico | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Hacking and phishing wave (Asos, Dustin) makes secure login a structural trend; stock already up from ~100 to ~130.

#### Reasoning

Hosts see cybersecurity as a supertrend that is 'only the beginning'. Companies and the public sector carry a security debt and will need to spend much more. Yubico is the clear Swedish play on secure employee logins. Much of the move may already be priced in.

#### Sell Triggers

- if security spending fails to accelerate
- if valuation runs ahead of order growth

> *"Där har man ju sett Yubico. Jag tyckte den stod i 100 nyss. Nu var det någon som sa att den stod i 130. De är ju supervinnare på det här."*

---

### 🟡 ETL — Eutelsat | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host's underperforming case; SpaceX spectrum purchases put a price on spectrum, which Eutelsat holds off-balance-sheet.

#### Reasoning

SpaceX bought spectrum, as it did earlier from EchoStar. That signals orbital spectrum is turning into a scarce, priced asset like land. Eutelsat holds many spectrum rights that are not valued on its balance sheet. The host thinks spectrum will become a very valuable asset, although the case has not worked so far.

#### Sell Triggers

- if spectrum prices fail to be recognised
- if Eutelsat's spectrum rights lapse or lose value

> *"Jag tror att spektrumet kommer att bli en väldigt tillgång."*

---

### 🟠 CAMX — Camurus | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Guest highlights the SORENTO phase 3 (CAM2029 in GEP-NET) readout as a catalyst; the study is running longer than expected.

#### Reasoning

This is the guest's (Savr analyst) view. Camurus is profitable, worth about SEK 40bn and has several products. The SORENTO readout at 194 events is an upcoming trigger, and a longer study could imply longer PFS. The guest prefers to scale down before clinical readouts rather than hold through them.

#### Sell Triggers

- if SORENTO fails to show PFS benefit
- before the readout as a risk-management step

> *"Och det är lite av det vi ser nu i Camurus till exempel."*

---
